units.headline: New test: evicted selected series record stays in WAL checkpoint
units.summary: Adds a test that evicts a series via CompactSelectedSeries, forces a WAL checkpoint, and checks the series record is still in it. It is test-only, so production behavior does not change.
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior.

units.headline: Head GC generalized with eviction predicate; stale counter decremented accurately
units.summary: Renames gcStaleSeries to gcSeries and adds a shouldEvict predicate. numStaleSeries is now decremented only by the number of deleted series that were actually stale, not by every removed series. Head eviction and metrics accounting change at runtime.
units.reason: Changes head eviction logic and the stale-series gauge accounting.
focus: the stale-series count is checked under the series lock, so it matches what was counted when the series became stale
all callers pass a predicate that keeps the old stale-only semantics where needed

units.headline: stripeSeries GC uses caller predicate instead of hardcoded stale check
units.summary: The hardcoded stale-NaN check is replaced by a caller-supplied shouldEvict predicate, so non-stale series can now be evicted. The function also returns how many of the deleted series were stale.
units.reason: Changes the condition that decides which series are deleted from the head.
focus: shouldEvict is called while the series lock is held (hasAppendIDAbove requires it)
the maxTime and pending-commit safety checks still run before the predicate
